items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh yeah. My friends really are Frank and all of those. They’re arrangers too.

ctx.x: My doctor said you find out who your friends really are.
Oh yeah. My friends really are Frank and all of those. They’re arrangers too. I can’t take nothing away from them. They’ll be my friends.
